elements.name: Cancer
elements.text: Cancer: emotional sensitivity and nurturing, the cardinal initiator in matters of intuition and relationship.

elements.name: The two horses
elements.text: Two horses in harness: the forces that move us, aligned only when intuition and rationality pull together.

elements.name: Reins
elements.text: Reins held taut in her hands: the determination and ambition that steer great movement toward its goal.
